report.answer: On this Linux Python 3.12.3 worktree, 9 live production config/artifact readers that do json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) HANDLE UTF-8 and REJECT_LOUD on the other three encodings. UTF-8-with-BOM fails with 'JSONDecodeError: Unexpected UTF-8 BOM (decode using utf-8-sig): line 1 column 1 (char 0)'. UTF-16-LE of ASCII JSON decodes as UTF-8 (NUL-dense) then fails with 'JSONDecodeError: Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes: line 1 column 2 (char 1)' — not an empty parse. Latin-1 of 'café' fails with "UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0xe9 in position 12: invalid continuation byte". Silent empties: [{'reader_id': 'inventory._load_json', 'encoding': 'utf-8-bom', 'classification': 'SILENT_EMPTY'}, {'reader_id': 'inventory._load_json', 'encoding': 'utf-16-le', 'classification': 'SILENT_EMPTY'}, {'reader_id': 'planted.silent_empty_decoder', 'encoding': 'utf-8-bom', 'classification': 'SILENT_EMPTY'}, {'reader_id': 'planted.silent_empty_decoder', 'encoding': 'utf-16-le', 'classification': 'SILENT_EMPTY'}, {'reader_id': 'planted.silent_empty_decoder', 'encoding': 'latin-1', 'classification': 'SILENT_EMPTY'}]. inventory._load_json swallows JSONDecodeError and returns {{}}; that is a runtime inventory reader, not a config reader, and is the live both-states control paired with planted.silent_empty_decoder. tools/plugin/heartbeat.py is absent on this worktree. PowerShell 7 was not present to re-emit BOM files; the BOM bytes EF BB BF were planted directly. SUCCESS:TST-0055
